visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with a ponytail, wearing a light blue cardigan and a matching pleated skirt, stands in a modern living room next to a green sofa. Another woman is lying perfectly stiff and horizontal on the sofa, her head resting on a bright orange pillow. The background features a concrete-textured wall, a wooden shelf with plush toys, and a framed minimalist line drawing. (2) The standing woman points a red rectangular object (representing a memory stick) toward the woman on the couch. High-contrast yellow text appears at the top of the frame. (3) The scene cuts to a medium shot where the standing woman looks surprised and gestures with her hands. The text changes to reflect a price increase. (4) The camera focuses on the legs of the woman on the sofa. The standing woman taps the lying woman's leg with the red object, causing her to flop her legs up and down in a stiff, fish-like motion. Large yellow text with a question mark appears in the center.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a bright, digital 'ding' notification sound accompanied by an upbeat, mid-tempo electronic percussion loop. (2) A distinctive 'cha-ching' sound effect of a mechanical cash register triggers on a visual cut, indicating a transaction or price change. (3) A famous meme voice sample of a male shouting 'Oh my god!' with high arousal and pitch variability plays, signifying shock. (4) The sequence concludes with a squelchy, percussive impact sound effect that syncs perfectly with the standing woman tapping the other woman's leg, followed by the electronic beat fading out.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a humorous visual metaphor to comment on the volatile and rising prices of computer memory (RAM). It personifies the 'memory' as a stiff, fish-like person who reacts physically when 'priced,' climaxing in a joke about market pricing being as unpredictable as a flopping fish.
